title: Collecting a Past-Due Subscription Charge on Paloma Business
content:
Every billing period of a Paloma Business account carries one subscription charge, worked out the same way whether it is taken at the start of the period or collected later from an account that fell past due because the balance could not cover it.

### When the charge is collected

When the charge of the current billing period could not be taken and the account is past due, the agent collects that period's subscription charge, worked out on the day of collection, from the balance once the balance covers it, and the account returns to active with no past-due date. The charge is booked as one subscription fee entry for that billing period.

| Situation on the account | Business effect of the collection |
|---|---|
| Past due; the current period's subscription charge was not taken; the balance now covers the charge | One subscription fee entry is booked for the current billing period and the amount leaves the balance |
| Account status after the collection | Active |
| Past-due date after the collection | None |

### Tool: `collect_overdue_subscription_325cf5bc`

**Capability.** Collects the subscription charge of the current billing period from a past-due Paloma Business account's balance and brings the account back into good standing. One call books one subscription fee entry for the account's current billing period with the amount given, takes that amount off the business balance, sets the account status to active and clears its past-due date. Afterwards the owner sees the subscription fee on the balance history and the account shown as active.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `business_account_id` | The Paloma Business account reference number of the account being brought back into good standing, as returned by the Paloma Business account lookup | Identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `amount_usd` | The subscription charge being collected for the current billing period | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with `ledger_entry_id` (reference of the subscription fee entry booked), `business_account_id` (the account), `billing_period_start` (YYYY-MM-DD start of the period the fee was booked for), `amount_usd` (USD amount collected, 2 decimals), `status` (the resulting account status, active) and `balance_usd` (resulting USD balance, 2 decimals). The presence of `ledger_entry_id` and status active indicates the collection completed.

### Contract Q&A

**Which billing period does the entry belong to?** The account's current billing period; the receipt states its start date.

**What does the account look like after a completed call?** Status active, no past-due date, the subscription fee on the balance history and the balance lowered by the amount collected.
